source: Frozen Bedrock on-demand price used by the prior controlled Sonnet 4.x experiments in this repository (src/research/hypothesis_engine/battery.py: PRICE_PER_1K_INPUT=0.003, PRICE_PER_1K_OUTPUT=0.015). Adopted verbatim as the frozen Item 6 execution price assumption; no network lookup performed.
provenance_note: These are the authoritative frozen execution price assumptions already applied in prior controlled experiments; if AWS list pricing differs at authorization time the human authorizer must re-freeze this table before execution.
reservation_uses_upper_margin: Reservation uses the frozen prices at multiplier 1.0 against a deliberately conservative input-token byte upper bound and the frozen MAX_TOKENS output bound; the conservatism lives in the token bounds, not a price inflation factor. A future human authorizer may set reservation_safety_multiplier > 1.0 to add price headroom.
